visual_review: Male sign: large r15 ring touching the left and bottom edges, a 45-degree shaft from the ring to the top-right corner, and an open right-angle arrowhead along the edges, as in the reference. Lucide mars construction.
omissions: The ring's upper-right quarter is two cubics through the grid point (32,16) so the shaft joins it with a shared endpoint (0.56 unit out-of-round, not visible at 48).
